A unique dining experience with a HCM twist
Jul 2026 • Couples
It feels trite to use the work 'experience' to describe going out for a meal, but in this case, it did feel like that was fundamental to what the restaurant wanted guests to feel.

From the 'hidden' location vibe, wandering up a dark stairwell to find the 'blue door', to the sense of eating in someone's home, sat around the kitchen and being immersed in the preperation of your food, the story the server told as each course was served and the food itself which was perfectly curated into a 7 course tasting menu that had rich flavours and 'oh wow' surprises.

Probably the best compliment i can offer is that we both smiled through our whole time at a.dau, it was a joyous experience.
